All probability/scale bytes, unused capacity and guards are checked after every warmup and timed attempt against canonical integer QK plus original online probability; independent CPU dots check the canonical scores. No oracle output enters candidate computation. Full prepared input bytes and tables remain unchanged. The fused no-score buffer stays sentinel in every captured attempt.
